idea-plugin.name: Codex CLI Companion
idea-plugin.description: Unofficial terminal-first companion that launches the interactive Codex CLI in a dedicated JetBrains Terminal tab at the current project root, then stage project file and selection references from the editor popup. Codex owns authentication, model selection, permissions, configuration, and session state in the terminal. Compatible Codex CLI sessions present file-change approvals as read-only native diffs while unsupported sessions continue in the normal terminal UI.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
• 0.4.3: Stream large Codex plugin-catalog frames through private disk-backed buffers so growing marketplace metadata cannot reset remote terminal sessions.
  • 0.4.2: Keep terminal command-state probes off IDE action threads and support fragmented WebSocket messages without resetting remote Codex sessions.
  • 0.4.1: Run native-bridge startup from an isolated private script instead of pasting multiline shell code into the interactive Terminal.
  • 0.4.0: Add transparent native read-only file-change approval diffs for compatible Codex CLI app-server sessions, with safe terminal fallback.
  • 0.3.1: Adopt the unique Codex CLI Companion Marketplace name and a publisher-owned plugin ID.
  • 0.3.0: Add Send to Codex for staging editor file and line references in a running Codex CLI terminal.
  • 0.2.1: Use the official Codex product mark and correct the plugin author metadata.
  • 0.2.0: Replace the app-server chat tool window with a terminal-first Codex CLI launcher.
